        return bool(self._async_url)

        sc = pipeline_response.http_response.status_code

            return "InProgress"

        if raw in ("failed",):

            return

            return

            self._azure_resource_ids_strings = list(azure_ids)

            return

            "azure_resource_ids must be a list of str or a list of AssignedProjectResource."
